items.title: Identify the concept of 'Zero' in Indian Mathematics
items.explanation: The text describes a concept invented by ancient Indian mathematicians that adds value to numbers. Without this concept, calculations in the modern digital world would be impossible. This refers to the number zero, which is essential for arithmetic operations like addition and subtraction.

items.title: Identify the practice related to physical and mental well-being
items.explanation: The text mentions an ancient Indian practice now popular globally that focuses on both physical and mental well-being. This refers to Yoga, which is a holistic practice combining physical postures, breathing techniques, and meditation.
